brief:
Hamas called Thursday for the prosecution of Israeli occupation leaders responsible for crimes against civilians in Gaza, demanding they face justice without escape, Shehab Wire reported. The statement followed the funeral of 105 bodies whose remains were laid to rest.

The Islamic Resistance Movement urged continued pursuit of accountability for those directing operations in Gaza, framing the burials as an occasion to renew calls for legal accountability against Israeli military and political leadership.

title: Hamas calls for prosecution of Israeli leaders after 105 bodies buried
